app.name: Meelo
app.one_liner: A self-hosted music server designed for collectors, emphasizing rich metadata, versioned albums/songs, and first-class music video support.

screens.name: Album Detail
screens.purpose: Display main album release alongside other versions, B-sides, and associated music videos.

screens.name: Artist Profile
screens.purpose: Show artist discography, area, and rare/unreleased tracks.

screens.name: Library Browser
screens.purpose: Browse albums, artists, and songs with deduplicated views while accessing alternate versions and related content.
primary_actions: Navigate to artist page showing rare tracks and area
View album details including releases and related tracks

rust_commands.name: classify_music_video
rust_commands.purpose: Categorize video files as music videos, interviews, behind-the-scenes, or trailers.

rust_commands.name: detect_song_versions
rust_commands.purpose: Group similar tracks into song versions to avoid duplication in browsing views.

rust_commands.name: scan_library
rust_commands.purpose: Ingest and parse local music files, extract embedded metadata, and enrich with external sources like MusicBrainz.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build library scanner with basic metadata extraction
week 1: Create deduplicated browsing view for albums and songs
week 1: Implement core data model for albums, releases, songs, and tracks
week 2: Add music video classification pipeline
week 2: Implement song version grouping logic
week 2: Integrate MusicBrainz for artist area and album type
week 3: Build artist profile showing rare tracks and area
week 3: Develop album detail screen with release switching
week 3: Enable playback queue with loop functionality
acceptance_tests: Artists display their geographic area when available from MusicBrainz.
B-sides and rare tracks appear on relevant album and artist pages but not in main browsing flows.
Given an album with multiple releases, only the main release appears in library browsing, but all releases are accessible on the album page.
Music videos are displayed on album and song pages and categorized correctly (e.g., not mixed with interviews).
When a song has multiple versions across releases, it appears once in song lists but links to all track instances.
